(\n        <EstimationTable \n          estimations={projects.map(p => ({\n            ...p,\n            totalCost: (p.totalCost || 0).toString(),\n            margin: p.margin?.toString() || '',\n            estimatedHours: '',\n            createdAt: p.createdAt?.toString() || new Date().toISOString(),\n            updatedAt: p.updatedAt?.toString() || new Date().toISOString()\n          }))} \n          onStatusChange={() => {}}\n        />\n      ) : (\n        <div className=\"grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6\">\n          {projects.map((project) => (\n            <Card key={project.id} className=\"cursor-pointer hover:shadow-lg transition-shadow\">\n              <CardHeader>\n                <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n                  <Badge variant={project.status === 'completed' ? ...estimationData, materials })}\n            onLaborUpdate={(laborItems) => {\n              // Append new labor items to existing ones instead of replacing\n              setEstimationData(prev => {\n                if (!prev) return prev;\n                const currentLabor = prev.labor || [];\n                const updatedLabor = [...currentLabor, ...laborItems];\n                return { ...prev, labor: updatedLabor };\n              });\n            }}\n            onConsumablesUpdate={(consumableItems) => {\n              // Append new consumable items to existing ones instead of replacing\n              setEstimationData(prev => {\n                if (!prev) return prev;\n                const currentConsumables = prev.consumables || [];\n                const updatedConsumables = [...currentConsumables, ...consumableItems];\n                return { ...prev, consumables: updatedConsumables };\n              });\n            }}\n            onLaborDelete={(operationId) => {\n              // Remove labor items associated with the deleted operation\n              setEstimationData(prev => {\n                if (!prev) return prev;\n                const filteredLabor = (prev.labor || []).filter(\n                  (item: any) => item.operationId !== operationId\n                );\n                return { ...prev, labor: filteredLabor };\n              });\n            }}\n            onConsumablesDelete={(operationId) => {\n              // Remove consumable items associated with the deleted operation\n              setEstimationData(prev => {\n                if (!prev) return prev;\n                const filteredConsumables = (prev.consumables || []).filter(\n                  (item: any) => item.operationId !== operationId\n                );\n                return { ...prev, consumables: filteredConsumables };\n              });\n            }}\n            onQuantityChange={(operationId, newQuantity, oldQuantity) => {\n              // Recalculate labor and consumables when operation quantity changes\n              setEstimationData(prev => {\n                if (!prev) return prev;\n                \n                // Handle zero to non-zero transition carefully\n                const scaleFactor = oldQuantity > 0 ? newQuantity / oldQuantity : 1;\n                \n                // Update labor hours proportionally\n                const updatedLabor = (prev.labor || []).map((item: any) => {\n                  if (item.operationId === operationId) {\n                    return {\n                      ...item,\n                      hours: item.hours * scaleFactor,\n                      totalCost: (item.hours * scaleFactor) * item.rate\n                    };\n                  }\n                  return item;\n                });\n                \n                // Update consumables quantities proportionally\n                const updatedConsumables = (prev.consumables || []).map((item: any) => {\n                  if (item.operationId === operationId) {\n                    const newQty = item.quantity * scaleFactor;\n                    return {\n                      ...item,\n                      quantity: newQty,\n                      totalCost: newQty * item.unitCost\n                    };\n                  }\n                  return item;\n                });\n                \n                return { \n                  ...prev, \n                  labor: updatedLabor,\n                  consumables: updatedConsumables\n                };\n              });\n            }}\n            onMaterialAreaWeightChange={(totalSurfaceArea, totalWeight) => {\n              // Recalculate coatings based on new total surface area and weight\n              setEstimationData(prev => {\n                if (!prev) return prev;\n                \n                const updatedCoatings = (prev.coatings || []).map((coating: any) => {\n                  // Recalculate based on coating type\n                  if (coating.coatingType === 'galvanizing' && coating.weightKg) {\n                    // Weight-based calculation for galvanizing\n                    coating.totalCost = coating.unitCost * totalWeight;\n                  } else if (coating.surfaceArea) {\n                    // Area-based calculation for paint/powder\n                    coating.totalCost = coating.unitCost * totalSurfaceArea * (coating.coats || 1);\n                  }\n                  return coating;\n                });\n                \n                return { ...prev, coatings: updatedCoatings };\n              });\n            }}\n            availableMaterials={materials}\n          />\n        </TabsContent>\n        \n        <TabsContent value=\"labor\">\n          <EnhancedLaborTab\n            labor={estimationData.labor}\n            setLabor={(labor) => setEstimationData({ ...estimationData, labor })}\n          />\n        </TabsContent>\n        \n        <TabsContent value=\"equipment\">\n          <EnhancedEquipmentTab\n            equipment={estimationData.equipment}\n            setEquipment={(equipment) => setEstimationData({ ...estimationData, equipment })}\n          />\n        </TabsContent>\n        \n        <TabsContent value=\"subcontractors\">\n          <SubcontractorsTab\n            subcontractors={estimationData.subcontractors}\n            setSubcontractors={(subcontractors) => setEstimationData({ ...estimationData, subcontractors })}\n          />\n        </TabsContent>\n coatings={estimationData.coatings}\n            onCoatingsChange={(coatings) => setEstimationData({ ...estimationData, coatings })}\n            materials={estimationData.materials}\n          />\n </div>\n  );\n}\n\n// Removed duplicate EstimationWorkspace function\n\n\n// Equipment tab with rental costs and operating hours\nfunction EquipmentTab({ equipment, onUpdate }: { equipment: estimationData.materials.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.totalCost || 0), 0);\n    const labor = estimationData.labor.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.totalCost || 0), 0);\n    const equipment = estimationData.equipment.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.totalCost || 0), 0);\n    const consumables = estimationData.consumables.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.totalCost || 0), 0);\n    const coatings = (estimationData.coatings || []).reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.totalCost || 0), 0);\n    const subcontractors = (estimationData.subcontractors || []).reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.totalCost || 0), 0);\n    \n    // FIXED: Include coatings and subcontractors in consistent calculation logic\n    const directCosts = materials + labor + equipment + consumables + coatings + subcontractors;\n    const overheads = directCosts * (estimationData.overheads.percentage / 100);\n    const margin = directCosts * (estimationData.margin.percentage / 100);\n    const revenueBeforeGST = directCosts + overheads + margin;\n    \n    // New Zealand GST is 15%\n    const gstAmount = revenueBeforeGST * 0.15;\n    const totalCostAfterGST = revenueBeforeGST + gstAmount;\n    \n    // Gross profit calculations (Revenue - COGS)\n    // COGS = Direct materials + Direct labor + Direct production costs\n    const grossProfit = revenueBeforeGST - directCosts;\n    const grossProfitPercentage = (grossProfit / revenueBeforeGST) * 100;\n    \n    // Calculate total labor hours for GP per hour\n    // Total Hours Worked = All staff involved in producing the service/product\n    const totalLaborHours = estimationData.labor.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.hours || 0), 0);\n    const grossProfitPerHour = totalLaborHours > 0 ? grossProfit / totalLaborHours : 0;\n    \n    // Additional KPIs\n    const materialCostRatio = directCosts > 0 ? (materials / directCosts) * 100 : 0;\n    const revenuePerLaborHour = totalLaborHours > 0 ? revenueBeforeGST / totalLaborHours : 0;\n    const overheadRecoveryRate = overheads > 0 ? (overheads / overheads) * 100 : 100; // Currently 100% as overheads are calculated based on percentage\n    \n    // Cost category percentages\n    const directCostPercentage = revenueBeforeGST > 0 ? (directCosts / revenueBeforeGST) * 100 : 0;\n    const overheadPercentage = revenueBeforeGST > 0 ? (overheads / revenueBeforeGST) * 100 : 0;\n    const marginPercentage = revenueBeforeGST > 0 ? '@/lib/offline-storage';\nimport { useToast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';\n\ninterface UseOfflineOptions {\n  enableSync?: boolean;\n  showToasts?: boolean;\n}\n\nexport function useOffline(options: UseOfflineOptions = {}) {\n  const { enableSync = true, showToasts = true } = options;\n  const [isOnline, setIsOnline] = useState(networkMonitor.getStatus());\n  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);\n  const { toast } = useToast();\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    // Initialize offline storage\n    offlineStorage.init().catch(console.error);\n\n    // Monitor network status\n    const unsubscribe = networkMonitor.addListener((online) => {\n      setIsOnline(online);\n      \n      if (showToasts) {\n        if (online) {\n          toast({\n            title: 'Back Online',\n            description: enableSync ? 'Syncing offline data...' : 'Connection restored',\n            duration: 3000,\n          });\n          \n          if (enableSync) {\n            syncOfflineData();\n          }\n        } else {\n          toast({\n            title: 'Working Offline',\n            description: 'Your changes will be saved and synced when online',\n            variant: 'destructive',\n            duration: 5000,\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    });\n\n    return () => {\n      unsubscribe();\n    };\n  }, [enableSync, showToasts]);\n\n  const syncOfflineData = useCallback(async () => {\n    if (!isOnline || isSyncing) return;\n    \n    setIsSyncing(true);\n    try {\n      // Sync queued requests\n      const requests = await offlineStorage.getQueuedRequests();\n      let successCount = 0;\n      \n      for (const request of requests) {\n        try {\n          const response = await fetch(request.url, {\n            method: request.method,\n            headers: request.headers,\n            body: request.body,\n          });\n          \n          if (response.ok) {\n            await offlineStorage.removeQueuedRequest(request.id!);\n            successCount++;\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('Failed to sync request:', error);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // Sync time entries\n      const timeEntries = await offlineStorage.getUnsyncedTimeEntries();\n      for (const entry of timeEntries) {\n        try {\n          const response = await fetch('/api/time/entries', {\n            method: 'POST',\n            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n            body: JSON.stringify(entry),\n          });\n          \n          if (response.ok) {\n            await offlineStorage.markTimeEntrySynced(entry.id);\n            successCount++;\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('Failed to sync time entry:', error);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      if (showToasts && successCount > 0) {\n        toast({\n          title: 'Sync Complete',\n          description: `${successCount} offline changes synced successfully`,\n          duration: 3000,\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Sync failed:', error);\n      if (showToasts) {\n        toast({\n          title: 'Sync Failed',\n          description: 'Some offline data could not be synced',\n          variant: 'destructive',\n        });\n      }\n    } finally {\n      setIsSyncing(false);\n    }\n  }, [isOnline, isSyncing, showToasts]);\n\n  const saveOffline = useCallback(async (key: string, data: any) => {\n    await offlineStorage.cacheData(key, data);\n  }, []);\n\n  const loadOffline = useCallback(async (key: string) => {\n    return await offlineStorage.getCachedData(key);\n  }, []);\n\n  return {\n    isOnline,\n    isSyncing,\n    syncOfflineData,\n    saveOffline,\n    loadOffline,\n    offlineFetch,\n  };\n}\n\n// Hook for offline-first forms\nexport function useOfflineForm<T>(formKey: string) {\n  const { saveOffline, loadOffline, isOnline } = useOffline();\n  const [isDirty, setIsDirty] = useState(false);\n\n  const saveForm = useCallback(async (data: T) => {\n    await saveOffline(formKey, data);\n    setIsDirty(false);\n  }, [formKey, saveOffline]);\n\n  const loadForm = useCallback(async (): Promise<T | null> => {\n    const data = await loadOffline(formKey);\n    return data;\n  }, [formKey, loadOffline]);\n\n  const clearForm = useCallback(async () => {\n    await saveOffline(formKey, null);\n    setIsDirty(false);\n  }, [formKey, saveOffline]);\n\n  return {\n    saveForm,\n    loadForm,\n    clearForm,\n    isDirty,\n    setIsDirty,\n    isOnline,\n supplierData: any, templateType: string): Promise<Buffer> {\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n      const doc = new PDFDocument({ \n        margin: 50,\n        // Enable font embedding to support UTF-8 characters properly\n        bufferPages: true,\n        autoFirstPage: true\n      });\n      const chunks: Buffer[] = [];\n\n      doc.on('data', (chunk) => chunks.push(chunk));\n      doc.on('end', () => resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks)));\n      doc.on('error', reject);\n\n      // Template color schemes\n      console.log('PDF Generation - templateType:', templateType);\n      const colors = {\n        standard: '#1e40af', // Blue\n        detailed: '#059669', // Green\n        simple: '#6b7280'    // Gray\n      };\n      const primaryColor = colors[templateType as keyof typeof colors] || colors.standard;\n      console.log('PDF Generation - Using color:', primaryColor);\n\n      // Header\n      doc.fillColor(primaryColor)\n        .fontSize(24)\n        .text('PURCHASE ORDER', 50, 50, { align: 'center' });\n\n      // Company info\n      doc.fillColor('#000000')\n        .fontSize(10)\n        .text('Lateral Engineering Limited', 50, 100)\n        .text('Auckland, New Zealand', 50, 115)\n        .text('Email: accounts@lateralengineering.co.nz', 50, 130);\n\n      // PO Details box\n      doc.rect(350, 100, 200, 80)\n        .stroke(primaryColor);\n      \n      doc.fontSize(10)\n        .text('PO Number:', 360, 110)\n        .font('Helvetica-Bold')\n        .text(poData.poNumber, 430, 110)\n        .font('Helvetica')\n doc.text(supplierData.email || '', 50, 250)\n        .text(supplierData.phone || '', 50, 265);\n\n      // Items header\n      const tableTop = 300;\n      doc.fillColor(primaryColor)\n        .rect(50, tableTop, 500, 25)\n        .fill()\n        .fillColor('#ffffff')\n        .fontSize(10)\n        .text('Item', 55, tableTop + 7)\n        .text('Description', 150, tableTop + 7)\n        .text('Qty', 350, tableTop + 7)\n        .text('Unit Price', 400, tableTop + 7)\n        .text('Total', 470, tableTop + 7);\n\n      // Items (placeholder for now - would be populated from actual items)\n      let yPosition = tableTop + 30;\n      doc.fillColor('#000000');\n      \n      if (poData.items && poData.items.length > 0) {\n        poData.items.forEach((item: any, index: number) => {\n          const unitPrice = parseFloat(item.unitPrice) || 0;\n          const totalPrice = parseFloat(item.totalPrice || item.lineTotal) || 0;\n          \n          doc.text(String(index + 1), 55, yPosition)\n            .text(item.description || 'Item', 150, yPosition)\n            .text(String(item.quantity || 0), 350, yPosition)\n            .text(`$${unitPrice.toFixed(2)}`, 400, yPosition)\n            .text(`$${totalPrice.toFixed(2)}`, 470, yPosition);\n          yPosition += 20;\n        });\n      } else {\n        doc.text('Items to be confirmed', 150, yPosition);\n        yPosition += 20;\n      }\n\n      // Total section\n      doc.moveTo(50, yPosition)\n        .lineTo(550, yPosition)\n        .stroke(primaryColor);\n      \n      yPosition += 10;\n      const totalAmount = typeof poData.totalAmount === 'number' ? poData.totalAmount : parseFloat(poData.totalAmount) || 0;\n      \n      // For detailed template, show GST breakdown\n      if (templateType === doc.font('Helvetica')\n          .fontSize(10)\n          .text('Subtotal:', 350, yPosition)\n          .text(`$${subtotal.toFixed(2)}`, 470, yPosition, { align: 'right', width: 70 });\n        \n string;\n  length: number;\n  quantity: number;\n  materialCode: string;\n  firstCutAngle: number;\n  secondCutAngle: number;\n  kerfWidth?: number;\n  description?: string;\n}\n\ninterface StockItem {\n  id: string;\n  length: number;\n  quantity: number;\n  materialCode: string;\n}\n\ninterface Cut {\n  id: string;\n  length: number;\n  startPosition: number;\n  endPosition: number;\n  firstCutAngle: number;\n  secondCutAngle: number;\n  description: string;\n  materialCode: string;\n  cuttingTime: number;\n  handlingTime: number;\n  kerfWidth: number;\n}\n\ninterface CuttingPlan {\n  id: string;\n  stockLength: number;\n  cuts: Cut[];\n  wasteLength: number;\n  efficiency: number;\n  totalCuts: number;\n  materialCode: string;\n  totalCuttingTime: number;\n  totalHandlingTime: number;\n}\n\nexport function optimizeCutting(\n  cutRequirements: CutRequirement[], \n  stockItems: StockItem[],\n  handlingTimes: any\n): CuttingPlan[] {\n  const plans: CuttingPlan[] = [];\n  \n  // Group by material\n  const materialGroups = cutRequirements.reduce((groups: Record<string, CutRequirement[]>, req) => {\n    if (!groups[req.materialCode]) groups[req.materialCode] = [];\n    groups[req.materialCode].push(req);\n    return groups;\n  }, {});\n\n  Object.entries(materialGroups).forEach(([materialCode, requirements]) => {\n    const availableStock = stockItems.filter(s => s.materialCode === materialCode);\n    if (availableStock.length === 0) return;\n\n    // Create individual cuts from requirements\n    const allCuts: any[] = [];\n    requirements.forEach(req => {\n      for (let i = 0; i < req.quantity; i++) {\n        allCuts.push({\n          originalId: req.id,\n          id: `${req.id}-${i + 1}`,\n          length: req.length,\n          firstCutAngle: req.firstCutAngle,\n          secondCutAngle: req.secondCutAngle,\n          description: req.description || `${req.length}mm piece`,\n          kerfWidth: req.kerfWidth || 2.4,\n          materialCode: materialCode\n        });\n      }\n    });\n\n    // Sort cuts by length (longest first)\n    allCuts.sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length);\n\n    // Create stock bars array\n    const stockBars: any[] = [];\n    availableStock.forEach(stock => {\n      for (let i = 0; i < stock.quantity; i++) {\n        stockBars.push({\n          length: stock.length,\n          materialCode: stock.materialCode,\n          barNumber: stockBars.length + 1\n        });\n      }\n    });\n\n    // Sort stock by length (shortest first)\n \"@/components/ui/tabs\";\nimport { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter } from \"@/components/ui/dialog\";\nimport { Textarea } from \"@/components/ui/textarea\";\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\";\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\";\nimport { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from \"@/components/ui/select\";\nimport { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger } from \"@/components/ui/tooltip\";\nimport { apiRequest } from \"@/lib/queryClient\";\nimport { toast } from \"@/hooks/use-toast\";\nimport { \n  Workflow, \n  CheckCircle, \n  Clock, \n  AlertCircle,\n  ChevronRight,\n  Package,\n  FileText,\n  User,\n  Building,\n  Upload,\n  Paperclip,\n  MessageSquare,\n  Edit,\n  Calendar,\n  Settings,\n  Eye,\n  Download,\n  Plus,\n  Trash2,\n  Shield,\n  Users,\n  FileCheck,\n  Milestone,\n  Lock,\n  Zap,\n  X,\n  File,\n  FileImage,\n  Maximize2\n} from \"lucide-react\";\n\ninterface LifecyclePhase {\n  id: number;\n  phaseName: string;\n  phaseCode: string;\n  status: string;\n  progress: number;\n  tasks: LifecycleTask[];\n}\n\ninterface LifecycleTask {\n  id: number;\n  taskName: string;\n  taskCode: string;\n  status: string;\n  responsibleParty: string;\n  approvalRequired?: boolean;\n  requiredDocuments?: string[];\n  automationTrigger?: string;\n  completedAt?: Date;\n  completedBy?: string;\n  notes?: string;\n  attachedDocuments?: TaskDocument[];\n}\n\ninterface TaskDocument {\n  id: number;\n  filename: string;\n  uploadedAt: Date;\n  uploadedBy: string;\n  fileSize: number;\n  fileType: string;\n}\n\ninterface LifecycleEvent {\n  id: number;\n  eventType: string;\n  description: string;\n  createdAt: Date;\n  userId: number;\n  userName: string;\n  metadata?: any;\n}\n\n// Helper function to format file size\nfunction formatFileSize(bytes: number): string {\n  if (!bytes) return '0 Bytes';\n  const k = 1024;\n  const sizes = ['Bytes', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];\n  const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));\n  return Math.round(bytes / Math.pow(k, i) * 100) / 100 + ' ' + sizes[i];\n}\n\nexport default function ProjectLifecycleTracker() {\n  const { projectId } = useParams();\n  const [, navigate] = useLocation();\n  const queryClient = useQueryClient();\n  \n  const projectIdNum = projectId ? parseInt(projectId) : undefined;\n  \n  // State management\n  const [selectedTask, setSelectedTask] = useState<LifecycleTask | null>(null);\n  const [showTaskDialog, setShowTaskDialog] = useState(false);\n  const [showDocumentDialog, setShowDocumentDialog] = useState(false);\n  const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState<'kanban' | 'timeline' | 'list'>('kanban');\n  const [stakeholderView, setStakeholderView] = useState<'all' | 'client' | 'engineer' | 'subcontractor'>('all');\n  const [taskNotes, setTaskNotes] = useState(\"\");\n  const [uploadFile, setUploadFile] = useState<File | null>(null);\n  const [previewDocument, setPreviewDocument] = useState<TaskDocument | null>(null);\n  const [showPreviewDialog, setShowPreviewDialog] = useState(false);\n\n  // Document download function\n  const downloadDocument = async (doc: TaskDocument) => {\n    try {\n      // Create a download link for the document\n      const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${projectIdNum}/lifecycle/documents/${doc.id}`, {\n        credentials: 'include'\n      });\n      \n      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Download failed');\n      \n      const blob = await response.blob();\n      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n      const a = document.createElement('a');\n      a.href = url;\n      a.download = doc.filename;\n      document.body.appendChild(a);\n      a.click();\n      document.body.removeChild(a);\n      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast({\n        title: \"Error\",\n        description: \"Failed to download document\",\n        variant: \"destructive\"\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Document delete function\n  const deleteDocument = async (doc: TaskDocument) => {\n    if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete \"${doc.filename}\"?`)) {\n      return;\n    }\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${projectIdNum}/lifecycle/documents/${doc.id}`, {\n        method: 'DELETE',\n        credentials: 'include',\n        headers: {\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify({ taskId: selectedTask?.id })\n      });\n      \n      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Delete failed');\n      \n      // Refresh the lifecycle data and re-select the task to show updated documents\n      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [`/api/projects/${projectIdNum}/lifecycle`] });\n      \n      // Keep the same task selected after refresh\n      const currentTaskId = selectedTask?.id;\n      if (currentTaskId) {\n        setTimeout(() => {\n          const updatedTask = lifecycle?.phases\n            .flatMap(p => p.tasks)\n            .find(t => t.id === currentTaskId);\n          if (updatedTask) {\n            setSelectedTask(updatedTask);\n          }\n        }, 100);\n      }\n      \n      toast({\n        title: \"Success\",\n        description: \"Document deleted successfully\"\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast({\n        title: \"Error\",\n        description: \"Failed to delete document\",\n        variant: \"destructive\"\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Fetch lifecycle data\n  const { data: lifecycle, isLoading } = useQuery({\n    queryKey: [`/api/projects/${projectIdNum}/lifecycle`],\n    enabled: !!projectIdNum,\n  });\n  \n  // Fetch project events\n  const { data: events = [] } = useQuery<LifecycleEvent[]>({\n    queryKey: [`/api/projects/${projectIdNum}/lifecycle/events`],\n    enabled: !!projectIdNum,\n  });\n\n  // Initialize lifecycle mutation\n  const initializeMutation = useMutation({\n    mutationFn: async () => {\n      return await apiRequest(`/api/projects/${projectIdNum}/lifecycle/initialize`, \"POST\", {});\n    },\n    onSuccess: () => {\n      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [`/api/projects/${projectIdNum}/lifecycle`] });\n      toast({ \n        title: \"Success\", \n        description: \"Project lifecycle initialized successfully\" \n      });\n    },\n    onError: (error: any) => {\n      toast({ \n        title: \"Error\", \n        description: error.message || \"Failed to initialize lifecycle\",\n        variant: \"destructive\"\n      });\n    }\n  });\n  \n  // Update task status mutation\n  const updateTaskMutation = useMutation({\n    mutationFn: async ({ taskId, status, notes }: { taskId: number; status: string; notes?: string }) => {\n      return await apiRequest(`/api/projects/${projectIdNum}/lifecycle/tasks/${taskId}`, \"PATCH\", { \n        status, \n        notes,\n        completedAt: status === 'completed' ? new Date() : null\n      });\n    },\n    onSuccess: () => {\n      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [`/api/projects/${projectIdNum}/lifecycle`] });\n      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [`/api/projects/${projectIdNum}/lifecycle/events`] });\n      toast({ title: \"Task updated successfully\" });\n      setShowTaskDialog(false);\n      setSelectedTask(null);\n    },\n    onError: (error: any) => {\n      toast({ \n        title: \"Error\", \n        description: error.message || \"Failed to update task\",\n        variant: \"destructive\"\n      });\n    }\n  });\n  \n  // Upload document mutation\n  const uploadDocumentMutation = useMutation({\n    mutationFn: async ({ taskId, file }: { taskId: number; file: File }) => {\n      const formData = new FormData();\n      formData.append('document', file);\n      formData.append('taskId', taskId.toString());\n      \n      const response = await fetch(`/api/projects/${projectIdNum}/lifecycle/documents`, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        body: formData,\n        credentials: 'include'\n      });\n      \n      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Upload failed');\n      return response.json();\n    },\n    onSuccess: () => {\n      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [`/api/projects/${projectIdNum}/lifecycle`] });\n      toast({ title: \"Document uploaded successfully\" });\n      setShowDocumentDialog(false);\n      setUploadFile(null);\n    },\n    onError: (error: any) => {\n      toast({ \n        title: \"Error\", \n        description: error.message || \"Failed to upload document\",\n        variant: \"destructive\"\n      });\n    }\n  });\n\n  if (!projectIdNum) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"container mx-auto p-6\">\n        <Card>\n          <CardContent className=\"p-6\">\n            <p className=\"text-muted-foreground\">Invalid project ID</p>\n          </CardContent>\n        </Card>\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (isLoading) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"container mx-auto p-6\">\n        <Card>\n          <CardContent className=\"p-6\">\n            <p className=\"text-muted-foreground\">Loading project lifecycle...</p>\n          </CardContent>\n        </Card>\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (!lifecycle || lifecycle.phases?.length === 0) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"container mx-auto p-6\">\n        <Card>\n          <CardContent className=\"p-6 text-center\">\n            <Workflow className=\"h-12 w-12 mx-auto mb-4 text-muted-foreground\" />\n            <h3 className=\"text-lg font-semibold mb-2\">No Lifecycle Tracking</h3>\n            <p className=\"text-muted-foreground mb-4\">This project doesn't have lifecycle tracking initialized yet.</p>\n            <Button \n              onClick={() => initializeMutation.mutate()}\n              disabled={initializeMutation.isPending}\n            >\n              {initializeMutation.isPending ? \"Initializing...\" : \"Initialize Lifecycle Tracking\"}\n            </Button>\n          </CardContent>\n        </Card>\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <TooltipProvider>\n      <div className=\"container mx-auto p-6 space-y-6\">\n        {/* Header */}\n        <div className=\"flex justify-between items-center\">\n          <div>\n            <h1 className=\"text-3xl font-bold\">Project Lifecycle Tracker</h1>\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"flex gap-2\">\n            <Tooltip>\n              <TooltipTrigger asChild>\n                <Button variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" onClick={() => navigate('/settings/lifecycle-templates')}>\n                  <Settings className=\"h-4 w-4 mr-1\" />\n                  Templates\n                </Button>\n              </TooltipTrigger>\n              <TooltipContent>\n                <p>Manage lifecycle templates</p>\n              </TooltipContent>\n            </Tooltip>\n            <Button variant=\"outline\" onClick={() => navigate(`/estimation`)}>\n              Back to Estimation\n            </Button>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        \n        {/* Stakeholder View Selector */}\n        <Card>\n          <CardHeader className=\"pb-3\">\n            <div className=\"flex justify-between items-center\">\n              <CardTitle className=\"text-lg\">Stakeholder View</CardTitle>\n              <Select value={stakeholderView} onValueChange={(value: any) => setStakeholderView(value)}>\n                <SelectTrigger className=\"w-48\">\n                  <SelectValue />\n                </SelectTrigger>\n                <SelectContent>\n                  <SelectItem value=\"all\">\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                      <Shield className=\"h-4 w-4\" />\n                      All (Internal)\n                    </div>\n                  </SelectItem>\n                  <SelectItem value=\"client\">\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                      <Building className=\"h-4 w-4\" />\n                      Client View\n                    </div>\n                  </SelectItem>\n                  <SelectItem value=\"engineer\">\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                      <FileText className=\"h-4 w-4\" />\n                      Engineer/Detailer\n                    </div>\n                  </SelectItem>\n                  <SelectItem value=\"subcontractor\">\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                      <Package className=\"h-4 w-4\" />\n                      Subcontractor\n                    </div>\n                  </SelectItem>\n                </SelectContent>\n              </Select>\n            </div>\n          </CardHeader>\n        </Card>\n\n        {/* Overall Progress */}\n        <Card>\n          <CardHeader className=\"pb-3\">\n            <CardTitle className=\"text-lg\">Overall Progress</CardTitle>\n          </CardHeader>\n          <CardContent>\n            <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n              <div className=\"flex justify-between text-sm\">\n                <span>Project Completion</span>\n                <span className=\"font-semibold\">{lifecycle.overallProgress || 0}%</span>\n              </div>\n              <Progress value={lifecycle.overallProgress || 0} className=\"h-3\" />\n            </div>\n          </CardContent>\n        </Card>\n\n        {/* View Tabs */}\n        <Tabs value={activeView} onValueChange={(value: any) => setActiveView(value)}>\n          <TabsList className=\"grid w-full grid-cols-3\">\n            <TabsTrigger value=\"kanban\">Kanban Board</TabsTrigger>\n            <TabsTrigger value=\"timeline\">Timeline</TabsTrigger>\n            <TabsTrigger value=\"list\">List View</TabsTrigger>\n          </TabsList>\n\n          <TabsContent value=\"kanban\" className=\"space-y-4\">\n            {/* Phase Cards */}\n            <div className=\"grid gap-4\">\n              {lifecycle.phases?.map((phase: LifecyclePhase) => (\n                <Card key={phase.id}>\n                  <CardHeader>\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n                      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n                        {phase.status === 'completed' ? (\n                          <CheckCircle className=\"h-5 w-5 text-green-600\" />\n                        ) : phase.status === 'active' ? (\n                          <Clock className=\"h-5 w-5 text-blue-600\" />\n                        ) : (\n                          <AlertCircle className=\"h-5 w-5 text-gray-400\" />\n                        )}\n                        <CardTitle className=\"text-lg\">{phase.phaseName}</CardTitle>\n                      </div>\n                      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                        <Badge variant={phase.status === 'completed' ? 'success' : phase.status === 'active' ? 'default' : 'secondary'}>\n                          {phase.status}\n                        </Badge>\n                        <span className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground\">{phase.progress || 0}% Complete</span>\n                      </div>\n                    </div>\n                  </CardHeader>\n                  <CardContent>\n                    <Progress value={phase.progress || 0} className=\"mb-4\" />\n                    \n                    {/* Tasks */}\n                    <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n                      {phase.tasks?.filter(task => {\n                        // Filter tasks based on stakeholder view\n                        if (stakeholderView === 'all') return true;\n                        if (stakeholderView === 'client' && ['Client', 'LEL'].includes(task.responsibleParty)) return true;\n                        if (stakeholderView === 'engineer' && task.responsibleParty === 'Engineer') return true;\n                        if (stakeholderView === 'subcontractor' && task.responsibleParty === 'Subcontractor') return true;\n                        return false;\n                      }).map((task: LifecycleTask) => (\n                        <div \n                          key={task.id} \n                          className=\"flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-lg border hover:shadow-sm transition-shadow cursor-pointer bg-white\"\n                          onClick={() => {\n                            setSelectedTask(task);\n                            setTaskNotes(task.notes || '');\n                            setShowTaskDialog(true);\n                          }}\n                        >\n                          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n                            <button\n                              onClick={(e) => {\n                                e.stopPropagation();\n                                const newStatus = task.status === 'completed' ? 'pending' : 'completed';\n                                updateTaskMutation.mutate({ taskId: task.id, status: newStatus });\n                              }}\n                              className=\"hover:scale-110 transition-transform\"\n                            >\n                              {task.status === 'completed' ? (\n                                <CheckCircle className=\"h-5 w-5 text-green-600\" />\n                              ) : (\n                                <div className=\"h-5 w-5 rounded-full border-2 border-gray-300 hover:border-blue-500\" />\n                              )}\n                            </button>\n                            <div>\n                              <span className={task.status === 'completed' ? 'line-through text-gray-500' : 'font-medium'}>\n                                {task.taskName}\n                              </span>\n                              {task.approvalRequired && (\n                                <Badge variant=\"outline\" className=\"ml-2 text-xs\">\n                                  <Lock className=\"h-3 w-3 mr-1\" />\n                                  Approval Required\n                                </Badge>\n                              )}\n                              {task.notes && (\n                                <div className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1 flex items-center gap-1\">\n                                  <MessageSquare className=\"h-3 w-3\" />\n                                  Notes available\n                                </div>\n                              )}\n                            </div>\n                          </div>\n                          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n                            {task.attachedDocuments && task.attachedDocuments.length > 0 && (\n                              <Badge variant=\"secondary\" className=\"text-xs\">\n                                <Paperclip className=\"h-3 w-3 mr-1\" />\n                                {task.attachedDocuments.length}\n                              </Badge>\n                            )}\n                            {task.automationTrigger && (\n                              <Tooltip>\n                                <TooltipTrigger>\n                                  <Badge variant=\"outline\" className=\"text-xs\">\n                                    <Zap className=\"h-3 w-3\" />\n                                  </Badge>\n                                </TooltipTrigger>\n                                <TooltipContent>\n                                  <p>Automated: {task.automationTrigger}</p>\n                                </TooltipContent>\n                              </Tooltip>\n                            )}\n                            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground\">\n                              {task.responsibleParty === 'LEL' && <User className=\"h-4 w-4\" />}\n                              {task.responsibleParty === 'Client' && <Building className=\"h-4 w-4\" />}\n                              {task.responsibleParty === 'Engineer' && <FileText className=\"h-4 w-4\" />}\n                              {task.responsibleParty === 'Subcontractor' && <Package className=\"h-4 w-4\" />}\n                              <span>{task.responsibleParty}</span>\n                            </div>\n                            <ChevronRight className=\"h-4 w-4 text-gray-400\" />\n                          </div>\n                        </div>\n                      ))}\n                    </div>\n                  </CardContent>\n                </Card>\n              ))}\n            </div>\n          </TabsContent>\n\n          <TabsContent value=\"timeline\" className=\"space-y-4\">\n            <Card>\n              <CardHeader>\n                <CardTitle>Project Timeline</CardTitle>\n              </CardHeader>\n              <CardContent>\n                <div className=\"space-y-6\">\n                  {events.slice(0, 10).map((event, index) => (\n                    <div key={event.id} className=\"flex gap-4\">\n                      <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center\">\n                        <div className={`w-3 h-3 rounded-full ${index === 0 ? 'bg-blue-600' : 'bg-gray-300'}`} />\n                        {index < events.length - 1 && (\n                          <div className=\"w-0.5 h-16 bg-gray-200\" />\n                        )}\n                      </div>\n                      <div className=\"flex-1 pb-6\">\n                        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground\">\n                          <Calendar className=\"h-4 w-4\" />\n                          {new Date(event.createdAt).toLocaleString()}\n                        </div>\n                        <p className=\"font-medium mt-1\">{event.description}</p>\n                        <p className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground\">by {event.userName}</p>\n                      </div>\n                    </div>\n                  ))}\n                </div>\n              </CardContent>\n            </Card>\n          </TabsContent>\n\n          <TabsContent value=\"list\" className=\"space-y-4\">\n            <Card>\n              <CardContent className=\"p-0\">\n                <table className=\"w-full\">\n                  <thead className=\"border-b\">\n                    <tr>\n                      <th className=\"text-left p-4\">Task</th>\n                      <th className=\"text-left p-4\">Phase</th>\n                      <th className=\"text-left p-4\">Responsible</th>\n                      <th className=\"text-left p-4\">Status</th>\n                      <th className=\"text-left p-4\">Documents</th>\n                      <th className=\"text-left p-4\">Actions</th>\n                    </tr>\n                  </thead>\n                  <tbody>\n                    {lifecycle.phases?.flatMap((phase: LifecyclePhase) =>\n                      phase.tasks?.map((task: LifecycleTask) => (\n                        <tr key={task.id} className=\"border-b hover:bg-gray-50\">\n                          <td className=\"p-4\">\n                            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                              {task.status === 'completed' ? (\n                                <CheckCircle className=\"h-4 w-4 text-green-600\" />\n                              ) : (\n                                <div className=\"h-4 w-4 rounded-full border-2 border-gray-300\" />\n                              )}\n                              <span className={task.status === 'completed' ? 'line-through text-gray-500' : ''}>\n                                {task.taskName}\n                              </span>\n                            </div>\n                          </td>\n                          <td className=\"p-4\">{phase.phaseName}</td>\n                          <td className=\"p-4\">{task.responsibleParty}</td>\n                          <td className=\"p-4\">\n                            <Badge variant={task.status === 'completed' ? 'success' : 'secondary'}>\n                              {task.status}\n                            </Badge>\n                          </td>\n                          <td className=\"p-4\">\n                            {task.attachedDocuments?.length || 0} files\n                          </td>\n                          <td className=\"p-4\">\n                            <Button\n                              size=\"sm\"\n                              variant=\"ghost\"\n                              onClick={() => {\n                                setSelectedTask(task);\n                                setTaskNotes(task.notes || '');\n                                setShowTaskDialog(true);\n                              }}\n                            >\n                              <Edit className=\"h-4 w-4\" />\n                            </Button>\n                          </td>\n                        </tr>\n                      ))\n                    )}\n                  </tbody>\n                </table>\n              </CardContent>\n            </Card>\n          </TabsContent>\n        </Tabs>\n\n        {/* Task Edit Dialog */}\n        <Dialog open={showTaskDialog} onOpenChange={setShowTaskDialog}>\n          <DialogContent className=\"max-w-2xl\">\n            <DialogHeader>\n              <DialogTitle>{selectedTask?.taskName}</DialogTitle>\n            </DialogHeader>\n            <div className=\"space-y-4\">\n              <div>\n                <Label>Status</Label>\n                <Select \n                  value={selectedTask?.status || 'pending'} \n                  onValueChange={(value) => {\n                    if (selectedTask) {\n                      updateTaskMutation.mutate({ \n                        taskId: selectedTask.id, \n                        status: value,\n                        notes: taskNotes \n                      });\n                    }\n                  }}\n                >\n                  <SelectTrigger>\n                    <SelectValue />\n                  </SelectTrigger>\n                  <SelectContent>\n                    <SelectItem value=\"pending\">Pending</SelectItem>\n                    <SelectItem value=\"in_progress\">In Progress</SelectItem>\n                    <SelectItem value=\"completed\">Completed</SelectItem>\n                    <SelectItem value=\"blocked\">Blocked</SelectItem>\n                  </SelectContent>\n                </Select>\n              </div>\n\n              <div>\n                <Label>Notes</Label>\n                <Textarea\n                  value={taskNotes}\n                  onChange={(e) => setTaskNotes(e.target.value)}\n                  placeholder=\"Add notes about this task...\"\n                  rows={4}\n                />\n              </div>\n\n              <div>\n                <Label>Documents</Label>\n                <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n                  {selectedTask?.attachedDocuments?.length > 0 ? (\n                    selectedTask.attachedDocuments.map((doc) => {\n                      const isImage = doc.fileType?.startsWith('image/');\n                      const isPDF = doc.fileType === 'application/pdf';\n                      const canPreview = isImage || isPDF;\n                      \n                      return (\n                        <div key={doc.id} className=\"flex items-center justify-between p-3 border rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50\">\n                          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3 flex-1\">\n                            {isImage ? <FileImage className=\"h-5 w-5 text-blue-500\" /> : \n                             isPDF ? <FileText className=\"h-5 w-5 text-red-500\" /> : \n                             <File className=\"h-5 w-5 text-gray-500\" />}\n                            <div className=\"flex-1\">\n                              <div className=\"font-medium text-sm\">{doc.filename}</div>\n                              <div className=\"text-xs text-muted-foreground\">\n                                {new Date(doc.uploadedAt).toLocaleDateString()} • {formatFileSize(doc.fileSize)}\n                              </div>\n                            </div>\n                          </div>\n                          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\n                            {canPreview && (\n                              <Button \n                                size=\"sm\" \n                                variant=\"ghost\"\n                                onClick={() => {\n                                  setPreviewDocument(doc);\n                                  setShowPreviewDialog(true);\n                                }}\n                              >\n                                <Eye className=\"h-4 w-4\" />\n                              </Button>\n                            )}\n                            <Button \n                              size=\"sm\" \n                              variant=\"ghost\"\n                              onClick={() => downloadDocument(doc)}\n                            >\n                              <Download className=\"h-4 w-4\" />\n                            </Button>\n                            <Button \n                              size=\"sm\" \n                              variant=\"ghost\"\n                              onClick={() => deleteDocument(doc)}\n                              className=\"text-red-500 hover:text-red-700\"\n                            >\n                              <Trash2 className=\"h-4 w-4\" />\n                            </Button>\n                          </div>\n                        </div>\n                      );\n                    })\n                  ) : (\n                    <div className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-2\">\n                      No documents uploaded yet\n                    </div>\n                  )}\n                  <Button\n                    variant=\"outline\"\n                    size=\"sm\"\n                    onClick={() => setShowDocumentDialog(true)}\n                    className=\"w-full\"\n                  >\n                    <Upload className=\"h-4 w-4 mr-2\" />\n                    Upload Document\n                  </Button>\n                </div>\n              </div>\n\n              {selectedTask?.requiredDocuments && selectedTask.requiredDocuments.length > 0 && (\n                <div>\n                  <Label>Required Documents</Label>\n                  <div 'contact tips': 'welding',\n    'grit': 'abrasives',\n    'paint': 'chemicals',\n    'thinner': 'chemicals'\n  };\n  return typeMap[type.toLowerCase()] || 'general';\n};\n\nexport function MaterialsTab({ materials, availableMaterials, onUpdate, onLaborUpdate, onConsumablesUpdate, onLaborDelete, onConsumablesDelete, onQuantityChange, onMaterialAreaWeightChange, projectId }: MaterialsTabProps) {\n  const [isAddDialogOpen, setIsAddDialogOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [editingMaterial, setEditingMaterial] = useState<MaterialCost | null>(null);\n  const [isEditDialogOpen, setIsEditDialogOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [showAiSuggestions, setShowAiSuggestions] = useState(false);\n  const [aiSuggestions, setAiSuggestions] = useState<MaterialCost[]>([]);\n  const [isAddChildDialogOpen, setIsAddChildDialogOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [addChildItemMaterialId, setAddChildItemMaterialId] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  \n  const { toast } = useToast();\n  const queryClient = useQueryClient();\n\n  // Calculate handling time and cost based on material weight\n  const calculateHandlingCost = (material: any, quantity: number) => {\n    if (!material || !material.weightPerMeter) return { time: 0, cost: 0 };\n    \n    const weightKg = material.weightPerMeter * quantity;\n    const timeMinutes = Math.max(5, Math.ceil(weightKg * 0.5)); // 0.5 min per kg, minimum 5 min\n    const cost = timeMinutes * 0.5; // $0.50 per minute handling\n    \n    return { time: timeMinutes, cost };\n  };\n\n  // Generate material designation based on material code\n  const generateMaterialDesignation = (materialCode: string, existingDesignations: string[]): string => {\n    // Extract type from material code\n    let prefix = 'M'; // Default for unknown types\n    \n    if (materialCode.includes('UC')) prefix = 'C';  // Column\n    else if (materialCode.includes('UB')) prefix = 'B';  // Beam\n    else if (materialCode.includes('PFC')) prefix = 'CH'; // Channel\n    else if (materialCode.includes('PLATE')) prefix = 'PL'; // Plate\n    else if (materialCode.includes('SHS')) prefix = 'SHS'; // Square Hollow\n    else if (materialCode.includes('RHS')) prefix = 'RHS'; // Rectangular Hollow\n    else if (materialCode.includes('CHS')) prefix = 'CHS'; // Circular Hollow\n    else if (materialCode.includes('ROD')) prefix = 'R';   // Rod\n    else if (materialCode.includes('ANGLE')) prefix = 'L'; // Angle\n    else if (materialCode.includes('FLAT')) prefix = 'FL'; // Flat Bar\n    \n    // Find next available number\n    let counter = 1;\n    while (existingDesignations.includes(`${prefix}${counter}`)) {\n      counter++;\n    }\n    \n    return `${prefix}${counter}`;\n  };\n\n  // Add new material to estimation\n  const addMaterial = (materialData: Partial<MaterialCost>) => {\n    // Get existing designations\n    const existingDesignations = materials.map(m => m.designation).filter(Boolean) as string[];\n    \n    // Generate designation if not provided\n    const designation = materialData.designation || \n      generateMaterialDesignation(materialData.materialCode || '', existingDesignations);\n    \n    const newMaterial: MaterialCost = {\n      id: Date.now().toString(),\n      materialId: materialData.materialId,\n      materialCode: materialData.materialCode || \"\",\n      materialName: materialData.materialName || \"\",\n      designation, // Auto-generated or provided designation\n      length: materialData.length || 6.0, // Default 6m length\n      lengthUnit: materialData.lengthUnit || 'm',\n      quantity: materialData.quantity || 1,\n      unit: materialData.unit || \"m\",\n      unitCost: materialData.unitCost || 0,\n      wasteFactor: materialData.wasteFactor || 5,\n      handlingTime: materialData.handlingTime || 0,\n      handlingCost: materialData.handlingCost || 0,\n      supplier: materialData.supplier || \"\",\n      leadTime: materialData.leadTime,\n      notes: materialData.notes,\n      totalCost: 0,\n      totalLength: 0, // Will be calculated below\n      childItems: [], // Initialize childItems array\n      ...materialData\n    };\n\n    // Calculate totals with waste factor\n    const adjustedQuantity = newMaterial.quantity * (1 + newMaterial.wasteFactor / 100);\n    newMaterial.totalCost = adjustedQuantity * newMaterial.unitCost + newMaterial.handlingCost;\n    newMaterial.totalLength = (newMaterial.length || 6.0) * newMaterial.quantity;\n\n    const updatedMaterials = [...materials, newMaterial];\n    onUpdate(updatedMaterials);\n    setIsAddDialogOpen(false);\n  };\n\n  // Update existing material\n  const updateMaterial = (materialData: Partial<MaterialCost>) => {\n    const updatedMaterials = materials.map(material => {\n      if (material.id === editingMaterial?.id) {\n        const updated = { ...material, ...materialData };\n        const adjustedQuantity = updated.quantity * (1 + updated.wasteFactor / 100);\n        updated.totalCost = adjustedQuantity * updated.unitCost + updated.handlingCost;\n        return updated;\n      }\n      return material;\n    });\n    onUpdate(updatedMaterials);\n    setIsEditDialogOpen(false);\n    setEditingMaterial(null);\n  };\n\n  // Remove material from estimation\n  const removeMaterial = (materialId: string) => {\n    const updatedMaterials = materials.filter(material => material.id !== materialId);\n    onUpdate(updatedMaterials);\n  };\n\n  // Update material field inline\n  const updateMaterialField = (id: string, field: keyof MaterialCost, value: any) => {\n    // Track old quantity for parent material quantity changes\n    let oldQuantity = 0;\n    let materialId = '';\n    \n    const updatedMaterials = materials.map(material => {\n      if (material.id === id) {\n        oldQuantity = material.quantity;\n        materialId = material.id;\n        const updated = { ...material, [field]: value };\n        // Recalculate totals if quantity, unitCost, or wasteFactor changed\n        if (['quantity', 'unitCost', 'wasteFactor', 'handlingCost'].includes(field)) {\n          const adjustedQuantity = updated.quantity * (1 + updated.wasteFactor / 100);\n          updated.totalCost = adjustedQuantity * updated.unitCost + updated.handlingCost;\n          // Update surface area and weight totals for coating integration\n          updated.totalSurfaceArea = updated.quantity * (updated.surfaceAreaPerMeter || 0);\n          updated.totalWeight = updated.quantity * (updated.weightPerMeter || 0);\n          \n          // Add child items total if any\n          if (updated.childItems && updated.childItems.length > 0) {\n            const childTotal = updated.childItems.reduce((sum, child) => sum + child.totalCost, 0);\n            updated.totalCost += childTotal;\n          }\n        }\n        return updated;\n      }\n      return material;\n    });\n    onUpdate(updatedMaterials);\n    \n    // Propagate parent material quantity changes to all associated child operations\n    if (field === 'quantity' && onQuantityChange && oldQuantity !== value) {\n      const material = materials.find(m => m.id === materialId);\n      if (material?.childItems) {\n        // Trigger recalculation for each child item\n        material.childItems.forEach(child => {\n          onQuantityChange(child.id, child.quantity, child.quantity);\n        });\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // Trigger coatings recalculation when surface area or weight changes\n    if (field === 'quantity' && onMaterialAreaWeightChange) {\n      const material = updatedMaterials.find(m => m.id === materialId);\n      if (material) {\n        const totalArea = updatedMaterials.reduce((sum, m) => sum + (m.totalSurfaceArea || 0), 0);\n        const totalWeight = updatedMaterials.reduce((sum, m) => sum + (m.totalWeight || 0), 0);\n        onMaterialAreaWeightChange(totalArea, totalWeight);\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Toggle expanded state for materials with child items\n  const toggleMaterialExpanded = (id: string) => {\n    const updatedMaterials = materials.map(material => {\n      if (material.id === id) {\n        return { ...material, isExpanded: !material.isExpanded };\n      }\n      return material;\n    });\n    onUpdate(updatedMaterials);\n  };\n\n  // Add child item to a material\n  const addChildItem = (materialId: string) => {\n    setAddChildItemMaterialId(materialId);\n    setIsAddChildDialogOpen(true);\n  };\n\n  // Handle operation submission from new dialog\n  const handleAddOperation = (operation: any) => {\n    const materialId = addChildItemMaterialId;\n    if (!materialId) {\n      console.error('No material ID set for adding operation');\n      return;\n    }\n    \n    console.log('Adding operation to material:', materialId, operation);\n\n    // Create child item from operation\n    const newChildItem: MaterialChildItem = {\n      id: `op-${Date.now()}`,\n      type: operation.type as MaterialChildItem['type'],\n      description: operation.description,\n      quantity: operation.quantity,\n      unit: operation.unit,\n      unitCost: operation.unitCost,\n      totalCost: operation.totalCost,\n      thickness: operation.thickness,\n      size: operation.size,\n      length: operation.length,\n      notes: operation.notes,\n      weldTime: operation.weldTime,\n      libraryComponentId: operation.libraryComponentId\n    };\n\n    const updatedMaterials = materials.map(material => {\n      if (material.id === materialId) {\n        const currentChildItems = material.childItems || [];\n        const updated = { \n          ...material, \n          childItems: [...currentChildItems, newChildItem],\n          isExpanded: true\n        };\n        \n        // Recalculate total including child items\n        const adjustedQuantity = updated.quantity * (1 + updated.wasteFactor / 100);\n        updated.totalCost = adjustedQuantity * updated.unitCost + updated.handlingCost;\n        const childTotal = updated.childItems.reduce((sum, child) => sum + child.totalCost, 0);\n        updated.totalCost += childTotal;\n        \n        return updated;\n      }\n      return material;\n    });\n\n    onUpdate(updatedMaterials);\n\n    // Route to appropriate tabs\n    if (operation.includeInLabor && onLaborUpdate) {\n      const laborRate = operation.laborLocation === 'site' ? 120 : 85;\n      const laborHours = operation.laborHours || 0;\n      // Map location to labor category\n      const laborCategory = operation.laborLocation === 'site' ? 'onsite' : 'workshop';\n      \n      onLaborUpdate([{\n        id: `labor-${Date.now()}`,\n        operationId: newChildItem.id,\n        description: operation.description,\n        hours: laborHours,\n        location: operation.laborLocation,\n        skillLevel: operation.skillLevel,\n        rate: laborRate,\n        totalCost: laborHours * laborRate, // Calculate totalCost\n        parentMaterialId: materialId,\n        category: laborCategory, // Use mapped category\n        subcategory: operation.type || 'fabrication', // Add subcategory\n        notes: operation.notes\n      }]);\n    }\n\n    // Handle consumables routing\n    if (operation.includeInConsumables && operation.consumablesData && operation.consumablesData.length > 0 && onConsumablesUpdate) {\n      // Get parent material for designation\n      const parentMaterial = materials.find(m => m.id === materialId);\n      \n      // Map consumables data to the format expected by consumables tab\n      const consumableItems = operation.consumablesData.map((item: any, index: number) => ({\n        id: `cons-${Date.now()}-${index}`,\n        designation: parentMaterial?.designation || '',\n        operationDesignation: `${parentMaterial?.designation || 'OP'}-${operation.type}-${index + 1}`,\n        category: getCategoryFromType(item.type),\n        itemType: item.type || 'consumable',\n        specification: item.description || '',\n        quantity: item.quantity || 1,\n        unit: item.unit || 'each',\n        unitCost: item.unitCost || 0,\n        totalCost: (item.quantity || 1) * (item.unitCost || 0),\n        notes: `Auto-generated from ${operation.description}`,\n        parentMaterialId: materialId,\n        operationId: newChildItem.id\n      }));\n      \n      onConsumablesUpdate(consumableItems);\n      console.log('Routed consumables to consumables tab:', consumableItems);\n    }\n\n    toast({\n      title: \"Operation Added\",\n      description: `${operation.description} added successfully`\n    });\n    \n    setIsAddChildDialogOpen(false);\n    setAddChildItemMaterialId(null);\n  };\n  \n  // Legacy handler for backward compatibility\n  const handleAddChildItem = (childData: Partial<MaterialChildItem>) => {\n    if (!addChildItemMaterialId) return;\n\n    const newChildItem: MaterialChildItem = {\n      id: Date.now().toString(),\n      type: childData.type || 'stiffener',\n      description: childData.description || '',\n      quantity: childData.quantity || 1,\n      unit: childData.unit || 'ea',\n      unitCost: childData.unitCost || 0,\n      totalCost: (childData.quantity || 1) * (childData.unitCost || 0),\n      thickness: childData.thickness,\n      size: childData.size,\n      length: childData.length,\n      notes: childData.notes || '',\n      weldTime: (childData as any).weldTime, // Include weld time from library component\n      libraryComponentId: (childData as any).libraryComponentId // Track [];\n        const updated = { \n          ...material, \n          childItems: [...childItems, newChildItem],\n          isExpanded: true \n        };\n        \n        // Recalculate total      const childTotal = updated.childItems.reduce((sum, child) => sum + child.totalCost, 0);\n        updated.totalCost += childTotal;\n        \n        return updated;\n      }\n      return 'baseplate', label: 'Base Plate', fields: ['thickness', 'size'] },\n    { value: 'cleat', label: 'Cleat', fields: ['size', 'thickness'] },\n    { value: 'bolt', label: 'Bolts', fields: ['size'] },\n    { value: 'weld', label: 'Welding', fields: ['length'] },\n    { value: 'other', label: 'Other', fields: [] }\n  ];\n\n  const selectedType = connectionTypes.find(t => t.value === formData.type);\n\n error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoadingComponents(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Auto-populate fields when a library component is selected\n  const handleLibrarySelection = (componentId: string) =>    i.material_id,\n          i.quantity_in_stock,\n          i.location,\n          COUNT(im.id) FILTER (WHERE im.movement_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as movements_this_month,\n GROUP BY i.id, i.material_id, i.quantity_in_stock, i.location\n      `);\n      \n      // Transform into lookup objects\n      const stockLevels: Record<number, number> = {};\n      const movements: Record<number, any> = {};\n      \n      for (const row of result.rows) {\n        const materialId = row.material_id as number;\n        stockLevels[materialId] = (stockLevels[materialId] || 0) +   }\n  });\n\n  // Cutting optimization routes\n  app.post(\"/api/optimize/linear\", async (req, res) => {\n    try {\n      const { requirements, stockLengths, algorithm = \"minimize_waste\" } = req.body;\n      \n      // Basic linear cutting optimization algorithm\n      const cuts: Array<{ length: number; quantity: number }> = requirements;\n      const stocks: Array<{ length: number; available: number }> = stockLengths;\n      \n      const optimizedPlans = [];\n      let totalWaste = 0;\n      let totalEfficiency = 0;\n      \n      for (const stock of stocks) {\n        if (stock.available <= 0) continue;\n        \n        const plan = {\n          stockLength: stock.length,\n          cuts: [],\n          wasteLength: stock.length,\n          efficiency: 0,\n        };\n        \n        let remainingLength = stock.length;\n        const kerf = 2.4; // mm kerf width\n        const userError = 0.5; // mm user error\n        const totalKerf = kerf + userError;\n        \n        // Sort cuts by length (descending for better optimization)\n        const sortedCuts = [...cuts].sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length);\n        \n        for (const cut of sortedCuts) {\n          let cutQuantity = 0;\n          while (cutQuantity < cut.quantity && remainingLength >= cut.length + totalKerf) {\n            plan.cuts.push({\n              length: cut.length,\n              position: stock.length - remainingLength,\n            });\n            remainingLength -= (cut.length + totalKerf);\n            cutQuantity++;\n          }\n        }\n        \n        plan.wasteLength = remainingLength;\n        plan.efficiency = ((stock.length - remainingLength) / stock.length) * 100;\n        \n        totalWaste += remainingLength;\n        totalEfficiency += plan.efficiency;\n        \n        optimizedPlans.push(plan);\n      }\n      \n      const avgEfficiency = totalEfficiency / optimizedPlans.length;\n      \n      res.json({\n        plans: optimizedPlans,\n        summary: {\n          totalWaste,\n          avgEfficiency,\n          algorithm,\n        },\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error optimizing cuts:\", error);\n      res.status(500).json({ error: \"Failed to optimize cuts\" });\n    }\n  });\n\n  // Bulk import/update materials endpoint\n  app.post(\"/api/materials/bulk-import\", async activeProfile = standardResult.rows[0];\n      }\n      \n      // Get role rates from the active profile\n      const roleRatesResult = await db.execute(sql`\n        SELECT \n          rr.*,\n roleRatesResult.rows;\n\n      // AI suggestion logic for labor categories based on materials\n      const laborSuggestions = materials.map((material: any) => {\n        let suggestedRole = 'Welder/Fabricator';\n        let estimatedHours = 1.0;\n        let skillLevel = 'standard';\n        \n        // Suggest appropriate roles based on material complexity\n        if (material.category?.includes('Universal Beam') || material.category?.includes('Column')) {\n          suggestedRole = 'Senior Estimator';\n          estimatedHours = 3.0;\n          skillLevel = 'senior';\n        } else if (material.category?.includes('Coating') || material.category?.includes('Paint')) {\n          suggestedRole = 'Welder/Fabricator';\n          estimatedHours = 0.5;\n estimatedHours = 2.0;\n          skillLevel = 'standard';\n        }\n\n        // Find matching role rate from profile\n        const roleRate = roleRates.find((r: any) => r.role_name === suggestedRole) || roleRates[0];\n        const baseRate = roleRate?.base_rate || activeProfile?.base_rate || 75;\n        const skillMultiplier = roleRate?.skill_multiplier || 1.0;\n        const estimatedHours,\n          skillLevel,\n          baseRate,\n          skillMultiplier,\n          hourlyRate: effectiveRate,\n          totalLaborCost: estimatedHours * effectiveRate,\n 'medium' : 'low'\n        };\n      });\n\n      res.json({\n        laborSuggestions,\n        totalLaborHours: laborSuggestions.reduce((sum: number, item: any) => sum + item.estimatedHours, 0),\n },\n        roleRates: roleRates.map((rate: any) => ({\n          roleId: rate.role_id,\n          roleName: rate.role_name,\n          baseRate: rate.base_rate,\n          skillMultiplier: app.get('/api/email-cost-import/stats', async (req, res) => {\n    try {\n      const user = await AuthService.getAuthenticatedUser(req);\n      \n      if (!user) {\n        return res.status(401).json({ error: \"Unauthorized\" });\n      }\n\n      // Get stats for email cost import\n      const today = new Date();\n      const startOfMonth = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), 1);\n      \n      // Count pending review costs from email_imported_costs  \n      const pendingResult = await db\n        .select({ count: sql`COUNT(*)` })\n        .from(emailImportedCosts)\n        .where(eq(emailImportedCosts.status, 'pending'))\n        .catch(() => [{ count: 0 }]);\n      \n      // Get total imported this month\n      const totalResult = await db\n        .select({\n          total: sql`COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)`\n        })\n        .from(emailImportedCosts)\n        .where(and(\n          gte(emailImportedCosts.importedAt, startOfMonth),\n          eq(emailImportedCosts.status, 'matched')\n        ))\n        .catch(() => [{ total: 0 }]);\n      \n      // Calculate variance percentage from matched costs vs estimates\n      const varianceResult = await db\n        .select({\n          actualTotal: sql`COALESCE(SUM(eic.amount), 0)`,\n          estimatedTotal: sql`COALESCE(SUM(j.estimated_value), 0)`\n        })\n        .from(emailImportedCosts.as('eic'))\n        .leftJoin(jobs.as('j'), eq(sql`eic.job_id`, sql`j.id`))\n        .where(and(\n          eq(sql`eic.status`, 'matched'),\n          gte(sql`eic.imported_at`, startOfMonth)\n        ))\n        .catch(() => [{ actualTotal: 0, estimatedTotal: 0 }]);\n      \n      const actualTotal = Number(varianceResult[0]?.actualTotal || 0);\n      const estimatedTotal = Number(varianceResult[0]?.estimatedTotal || 0);\n      const variancePercent = estimatedTotal > 0 \n        ? Math.round(((actualTotal - estimatedTotal) / estimatedTotal) * 100)\n        : 0;\n      \n      // Calculate auto-match rate\n      const matchRateResult = await db\n        .select({\n          totalImported: sql`COUNT(*)`,\n          autoMatched: sql`COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'matched')`\n        })\n        .from(emailImportedCosts)\n        .where(gte(emailImportedCosts.importedAt, startOfMonth))\n        .catch(() => [{ totalImported: 0, autoMatched: 0 }]);\n      \n      const totalImported = Number(matchRateResult[0]?.totalImported || 0);\n      const autoMatched = Number(matchRateResult[0]?.autoMatched || 0);\n      const autoMatchRate = totalImported > 0 \n        ? Math.round((autoMatched / totalImported) * 100)\n        : 0;\n      \n      res.json({\n        pendingReview: Number(pendingResult[0]?.count || 0),\n        totalImported: Math.round(Number(totalResult[0]?.total || 0)),\n        variancePercent: variancePercent,\n        autoMatchRate: autoMatchRate\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error fetching };\n\n  // Handle tab change with auto-save logic\n  const handleTabChange = async (tabValue: string) => {\n    if ((tabValue === \"contacts\" || tabValue === \"locations\") && mode === \"create\" &&     }\n\n      // Prevent multiple auto-saves\n      if (autoSaveMutation.isPending) {\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Auto-save the supplier before switching to contacts or locations\n      try sequence = await db.select()\n      .from(numberingSequences)\n      .where(eq(numberingSequences.sequenceType, sequenceType))\n      .limit(1);\n    \n    if (sequence.length === 0) {\n      // includeArchived?: boolean; showArchived?: boolean }): Promise<PurchaseOrder[]> {\n    // Start with base query\n    let baseQuery = db.select().from(purchaseOrders);\n    \n    // Filter by status, supplier, or job if provided\n    if (filters) {\n      const conditions = [];\n      \n      if (filters.status) {\n        conditions.push(eq(purchaseOrders.status, filters.status));\n      }\n      \n      if (filters.supplierId) {\n        conditions.push(eq(purchaseOrders.supplierId, filters.supplierId));\n      }\n      \n      if (filters.jobId) {\n        conditions.push(eq(purchaseOrders.jobId, filters.jobId));\n      }\n      \n      // Only show archived if explicitly requested\n      if (filters.showArchived) {\n        conditions.push(eq(purchaseOrders.isArchived, true));\n      } else if (!filters.includeArchived) {\n        // Default: hide archived \n        conditions.push(eq(purchaseOrders.isArchived, false));\n      }\n      \n      if (conditions.length > 0) {\n        baseQuery = baseQuery.where(and(...conditions));\n      }\n    } else {\n      // Default: hide archived only\n      baseQuery = baseQuery.where(eq(purchaseOrders.isArchived, false));\n    }\n    \n    // Get all orders and then filter out 'returned_to_requisition' in memory\n    const orders = await baseQuery.orderBy(desc(purchaseOrders.createdAt));\n    \n    // Filter out returned_to_requisition status in memory\n    return orders.filter(order => order.status !== 'returned_to_requisition');\n getRfqRequests(filters?: { status?: string; statusList?: string[]; jobId?: number }): Promise<any[]> {\n    let query = db.select().from(rfqRequests);\n    \n    if (filters) {\n      const conditions query = query.where(and(...conditions)) as any;\n      }\n    }\n    \n    const rfqs = await query.orderBy(desc(rfqRequests.createdAt));\n    \n    // Add response counts to each RFQ\n    const }\n\n  async getRfqRequest(id: number): Promise<RfqRequest | undefined> {\n    const [rfq] = await db.select().from(rfqRequests).where(eq(rfqRequests.id, id));\n    return rfq;\n  }\n\n  async date handling - ensure all date fields are proper Date objects or null\n    const sanitizedData: any = { ...rfq };\n    \n    // Handle date fields that might come as strings\n    const dateFields = ['responseDeadline', 'deliveryRequiredBy', 'sentAt', 'closedAt'];\n    \n    for (const field of dateFields) {\n      if (field in sanitizedData) {\n        const value = sanitizedData[field];\n        \n        if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {\n          // Keep null, remove undefined/empty strings\n          sanitizedData[field] = null;\n        } else if (typeof value === 'string') {\n          // Convert string to Date\n          const date = new Date(value);\n          if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {\n            console.error(`Invalid date string for field ${field}:`, value);\n            // Remove invalid dates rather than causing an error\n            delete sanitizedData[field];\n          } else {\n            sanitizedData[field] = date;\n          }\n        } else if (value instanceof Date) {\n          // Already a Date object, validate it\n          if (isNaN(value.getTime())) {\n            console.error(`Invalid Date object for field ${field}`);\n            delete sanitizedData[field];\n          }\n        } else {\n          // Unknown type, remove it\n          console.error(`Unknown type for date field ${field}:`, typeof value);\n          delete sanitizedData[field];\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // Remove any undefined values to prevent Drizzle errors\n    Object.keys(sanitizedData).forEach(key => {\n      if (sanitizedData[key] === undefined) {\n        delete sanitizedData[key];\n      }\n    });\n    \n    console.log('Updating RFQ in storage with sanitized data:', {\n      id,\n      fields:      NULL, NULL, NOW())`\n    );\n    \n    // Also write to the comprehensive system_audit_log table for Audit Center\n    const [user] = await db.select().from(users).where(eq(users.id, params.userId)).limit(1);\n    \n    // Map procurement actions to event subtypes\n    const eventSubtypeMapping: Record<string, string> = {\n      'RFQ_CREATED': 'rfq_created',\n      'RFQ_SENT': 'rfq_sent',\n      'QUOTE_SUBMITTED': 'quote_submitted',\n      'QUOTE_EVALUATED': 'quote_evaluated',\n      'QUOTE_WINNER_SELECTED': 'winner_selected',\n      'QUOTE_WINNER_SELECTED_WITH_OVERRIDE': 'requisition_rejected',\n      'GOODS_RECEIVED': 'goods_received',\n      'INVOICE_PROCESSED': 'invoice_processed'\n    };\n    \n    // Determine event type based on action\n    let eventType = 'create';\n    if (params.action.includes('UPDATE') || params.action.includes('EDIT')) eventType = 'update';\n    if (params.action.includes('DELETE') || params.action.includes('REJECT')) eventType = 'delete';\n    if (params.action.includes('VIEW') || params.action.includes('EXPORT')) eventType = 'view';\n    if (params.action.includes('SENT') || params.action.includes('NOTIFICATION')) eventType = 'notification';\n    if (params.action.includes('SELECTED') || params.action.includes('EVALUATED')) eventType = 'decision';\n    \n    // Determine severity\n    let severity = 'info';\n    if    await db.insert(systemAuditLog).values({\n      eventCategory: 'procurement',\n      eventType,\n      eventSubtype: eventSubtypeMapping[params.action] || params.action.toLowerCase(),\n      severity,\n      entityType: params.entityType.toLowerCase(),\n      entityId: params.entityId,\n      entityDescription: `${params.entityType} #${params.entityId}`,\n      userId: params.userId,\n
